svg.text: The same four devices in each variant. IN at the left, OUT at the right; vents fill the rest.
From the top, each unit as full as it goes: the frames stair-step.
The lower units fill first (whole width); beside the name only what is left.
Every unit's frames start after the name, one under another; a plate under the name.
B upside down: frames on top across the whole width, the name in the last unit.
B's units (the lower ones first, the whole width), every frame from the left; vents only at the right.
